script_text: Stop! Leo, the universe just handed you the most powerful transit of the entire year and you didn't even notice yet. Jupiter is sweeping into your 1st House of Self, forming an explosive conjunction with your ruling Sun — pure fire energy igniting right now. Your confidence is being supercharged, and every single room you enter will feel your heat radiate differently. Meanwhile, Pluto is grinding through your 7th House of Partnerships, forcing radical honesty into your closest bonds. If single, this transit magnetizes a deeply transformative connection. If taken, buried truths finally surface demanding real transparency. The transiting Sun moves through your 2nd House of Finances, aligning with Mercury to spotlight a potential raise or fresh income channel opening up. Here's the warning: don't let Jupiter's golden expansion trick you into overcommitting. Pace yourself. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
